page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Top: page number 64 at the left and running head CONTROVERSIÆ at the centre. Below the head, the end of a paragraph carried over from the previous page. Then a note set in smaller type between two rules, mid-page above the division heading. Then the division heading, title, and running text. Catchword "ipsum" at the lower right.

main_text.head: ARTICULUS XVIII. De Incarnatione Filii DEI.
main_text.p: Confitemur itaque DEUM promissio-nem Patribus per os sanctorum Prophetarum factam implevisse, quum constituto ab se tempore Filium suum unicum & æternum in hunc mundum misit : qui formam servi assumpsit, similis hominibus factus, & veram naturam humanam cum omnibus ipsius infirmitatibus, excepto peccato, vere assumpsit, dum conceptus est in utero beatæ Virginis Mariæ, virtute Spiritus Sancti, absque ullâ maris operâ. Eam porrò naturam humanam non quoad corpus tantum induit, sed etiam quoad animam : fuit enim vera animâ humanâ præditus, ut verus esset homo. Etenim cum anima non minus quam ipsum
Sunt inter REMONSTRANTES, qui in controversiam aliquando vocarunt, an per semen mulieris, contriturum caput serpentis, promissum Gen. 3. 15. sit intelligendus DEI Filius ex muliere nasciturus.

page.notes: The foot note is set in smaller type between two full-width rules, above the division heading, and is placed here after the main text. The word "ipsum" at the lower right is a catchword. Faint show-through from the reverse page is ignored. The printed "redde-ret" contains a Cyrillic-looking letter in the source scan; it is read as the Latin letter e. The heading's "ARTICVLVS" is written ARTICULUS and "Filij" is written Filii, following the u/v and i/j rule. Small-caps words "DEVM" and "DEI" are written DEUM and DEI.
